title: The Outback, Alice Springs, Australia, 1985 — rider on a camel
summary: A photo of a person wrapped in a grey blanket riding a saddled camel in a dusty yard, captioned The Outback, Alice Springs, Australia, 1985. Follows the verse about Abraham's servant taking ten camels.

pictures.description: Colour photograph of a person with glasses, wrapped in a grey blanket or cloak, sitting on a saddled brown camel with a blue halter. The camel stands in a dusty yard with other camels behind it, a bare tree and a shed under a clear blue sky.
